Definition: from G2095 and the base of G2041; a worker of good, i.e. (specially) a philanthropist:--benefactor.
BiblicalUsage: The word euergétēs carries the sense of benefactor. In Luke 22:25, the text says "and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of euergétēs I do not force more than it gives: benefactor.
